MANDATORY pure pitch black void background only, absolutely NO studio backdrop NO texture NO grey NO gradient. Composition: each woman's own pose as described, inner arms not crossing her neighbours. Pattern density maximum on all 5, zero bare skin from neck to ankle. Shot on a Hasselblad X2D, 5:4 aspect ratio.
